name: Sovryn loan-closing cross-contract reentrancy into iToken mint
summary: Sovryn's LoanClosingsWith protocol module reduced the lender pool's principalTotal in _settleInterest before pulling the repayment (an rUSDT ERC777 transferFrom that calls the payer's tokensToSend hook) or refunding native RBTC to the borrower. From those callbacks the attacker minted iUSDT or iRBTC while the pool's totalAssetSupply omitted the repaid principal, i.e. at a depressed tokenPrice, then burned the iTokens at the corrected price once the close finished. Repeated with flash-swapped collateral, this drained the iUSDT and iRBTC lending pools.
notes: Sovryn multisig 0x924f5ad34698fd20c90fe5d5a8a0abd3b42dc711 executed replaceContract for LoanClosingsWith, emitting ProtocolModuleContractReplaced(prev 0xfe901c84ed9c827b48ca3af8b2c8a6221638eb8a, new 0x9b93e1fb9545e845d2ace49e3913be50166f9e8f, 'LoanClosingsWith'). logicTargets(closeWithDeposit 0x366f513b) reads 0xfe901c84 at block 4544165 and 0x9b93e1fb at 4544166 and 4689412; closeWithSwap 0xf8de21d2 also maps to 0x9b93e1fb at 4689412. It is the last LoanClosingsWith replacement before the exploit; the next one moves the selectors to the fixed module 0x88500b472a245a937d07c53b22a107ce1901d30f at block 4744854.

Exact net depletion of the Sovryn victim set {iUSDT 0x849c47f9c259e9d62f289bf1b2729039698d8387, iRBTC 0xa9dcdc63eabb8a2b6f39d7ff9429d88340044a7a, protocol 0x5a0d867e0d70fcc6ade25c3f1b89d618b5b4eaa7} across 110 successful attacker transactions (source-12): 36 setup borrows plus 36 rUSDT-leg exploits through attack contracts 0xe40151f2 (01:37-02:49 UTC) and 0xdaa2e727 (03:02-04:07 UTC), and 38 self-contained RBTC-leg exploits through 0xa893cdcb (06:43-07:37 UTC, last source-13), all on 2022-10-04 from EOA 0xc92ebecda030234c10e149beead6bba61197531a. rUSDT is entirely iUSDT-to-attacker net flow (164,360.168033 to 0xe40151f2, 118,693.860995 to 0xdaa2e727). RBTC combines WRBTC Transfer logs and native value frames: iRBTC to 0xa893cdcb 147.537139 (WRBTC 1139.937139 out and 1095 in, 102.6 native out) and protocol to 0xa893cdcb 0.928868 native, less 103.682768 WRBTC paid into the protocol by the Sovryn AMM when closeWithSwap converted the attacker's own XUSD collateral to repay its 2.7-RBTC loans; that repayment is attacker-supplied input and is netted. Gross treatment: the 2,804.4 XUSD of trading fees the protocol kept from the attacker (38 x 73.8) and the later recoveries in source-9 (17.717 RBTC, 19,511.1505 USDT, ETH and BNB) are not deducted. Excluded: 6,949.589485 SOV trading rebates the protocol sent to LockedSOV 0xb4e4517ca4edf591dcafb702999f04f02e57d978 for the attack contracts (vesting-locked, about 2.8k USD); tx 0x4dda1cc8e7bd813cd136a83dffa6be5d456414684f5351d371d276e7e084325f, whose reentrant iRBTC mint and burn returned exactly the 15 WRBTC deposited and which left an open 2.7-RBTC loan backed by 82,000 XUSD; and setup loans never closed (nonces 91, 104, 108, 130: 1 rUSDT against 0.001 WRBTC each). rUSDT (Sovryn-bridged USDT, 18 decimals) is valued at par (DefiLlama USDT 1.00017 at the anchor). RBTC is pegged 1:1 to BTC by the Powpeg; the whole RBTC depletion falls in 1664865799..1664869002 and DefiLlama's rsk WRBTC series has no sample between 1664847694 and 1664873182, so the BTC quote sampled at 1664866907 inside that window is used. The Sovryn post-mortem (source-9) reports 44.9368 RBTC and 282,351.9644 rUSDT extracted, within 0.35% and 0.25% of these onchain figures.

The LoanClosingsWith module bytecode is unverified on Blockscout and absent from the repository's deployment address lists; its identity rests on the module-replacement event name, the logicTargets mapping for both closing selectors, the anchor trace, and the pre-fix LoanClosingsWith/LoanClosingsShared source at the parent of the fix merge (source-8), whose ordering matches the anchor's log sequence.

Only the protocol module is carried. The consuming half, iUSDT's LoanTokenLogicLM 0x82c49ec67389b6e8c377ed1da7816b9add4e3b1e (mint, burn and tokenPrice without a cross-contract guard, reached iUSDT 0x849c47f9 -> LoanTokenLogicProxy 0x8567ab78bae6f533e8fd3dc221fd680019f452cc -> beacon 0xd7fb11f4b71c6bfe9db50f3c02c821af8f616501), was registered earlier in the same upgrade batch (beacon getTarget(0x40c10f19) is 0x2564100636274dcd041a952a80bf20e8d8bd57ae at block 4544150 and 0x82c49ec6 at 4544151, tx 0x646155b650cf74c78ae0ad0e6472a24e5fef901276abc7666c1b9275e61c29e4; moduleUpgradeLog length 3 and activeModuleIndex 2 at block 4689412), so it cannot supply a later knot. The iRBTC logic was not executed by the anchor. The LoanMaintenance view module (block 4544170) and setSwapsImplContract (multisig tx 1054, block 4544171) postdate the reset within the same batch but are not defect-bearing.
